context:
# Apple Services extracts
Original factual extracts from Apple Inc. FY2024 Q2 Form 10-Q, filed 2024-05-03, quarter ended 2024-03-30. Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000069/aapl-20240330.htm
Revenue and gross margin tables have separate three-month (Q2) and six-month (H1) columns, with 2024 and 2023 comparisons. Dollar amounts are USD millions. The services table preserves these headers. gross_profit_million is the dollar gross margin amount, not a percentage. Fiscal Q1 is the part of H1 preceding Q2. Ratios should be derived from reported dollar amounts rather than the filing's rounded margin percentages. A percentage-point difference subtracts the two percentage levels.
This fixture contains concise factual extracts and original annotations, not the full issuer document. Changed-data controls are synthetic.


Observed accession-specific factual table extract, deterministically normalized. This is a previously exposed regression question, not a newly unseen evaluation.

answers.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN revenue_million END) r2,MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN revenue_million END) rh,MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN gross_profit_million END) g2,MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN gross_profit_million END) gh FROM services WHERE entity='Apple' AND fiscal_year=2024) SELECT rh-r2 AS value FROM p

WITH p AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN revenue_million END) r2,MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN revenue_million END) rh,MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN gross_profit_million END) g2,MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN gross_profit_million END) gh FROM services WHERE entity='Apple' AND fiscal_year=2024) SELECT gh-g2 AS value FROM p

WITH p AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN revenue_million END) r2,MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN revenue_million END) rh,MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN gross_profit_million END) g2,MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN gross_profit_million END) gh FROM services WHERE entity='Apple' AND fiscal_year=2024) SELECT 100.0*(gh-g2)/(rh-r2) AS value FROM p

WITH p AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN revenue_million END) r2,MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN revenue_million END) rh,MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN gross_profit_million END) g2,MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN gross_profit_million END) gh FROM services WHERE entity='Apple' AND fiscal_year=2024) SELECT 100.0*g2/r2-100.0*(gh-g2)/(rh-r2) AS value FROM p
